scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn index:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check app tests index.py ../../perf && uv run ruff format --check app tests index.py ../../perf && uv run lint-imports
scripts.format: pnpm --filter web format && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format app tests index.py ../../perf
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && cd apps/api && uv run mypy
scripts.test:stripe-sandbox: cd apps/api && STRIPE_SANDBOX_TESTS=1 uv run pytest tests/sandbox -m sandbox
scripts.contracts: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli openapi --output ../../packages/contracts/openapi.json && cd ../.. && pnpm --filter web contracts
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli migrate
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli seed
scripts.db:reset: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli reset --seed
scripts.billing:reconcile: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli reconcile
scripts.setup:stripe: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.cli setup-stripe
